name: zvideo_dd_image_lazy_create_video_memory_surface
description: zVideo_dd::Image_LazyCreateVideoMemorySurface gates video-memory image surface creation on half-resolution backbuffer mode or selected-device feature flags, then tail-calls the shared backing-surface creator with the selected DirectDraw caps.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw image/surface source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a84c0 validates fastcall ECX=image, unconditional read of g_zVideo_pSelectedHwApiDeviceRecord->m_deviceFeatureFlags, early return when g_zVideo_UseHalfResBackbuffer is zero and feature flags are zero, cap construction as DDSCAPS_VIDEOMEMORY plus DDSCAPS_NONLOCALVIDMEM when feature flags are nonzero, and tail call to zVideo_dd::Image_LazyCreateBackingSurface at 0x4a83d0.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a84c0 has no warnings in the current database and matches the corrected source implementation. The prior limited reconstruction marker is stale for this session's evidence.
The dependency frontier shows no remaining authored source blockers; the only direct authored callee is zVideo_dd::Image_LazyCreateBackingSurface, which is tier C or better.

The native smoke verifies the no-half-res/no-feature early return without creating a DirectDraw surface, half-resolution creation using DDSCAPS_VIDEOMEMORY, feature-driven creation using DDSCAPS_NONLOCALVIDMEM | DDSCAPS_VIDEOMEMORY, descriptor propagation through the shared backing-surface creator, and successful pixel population onto the created surface.
